summary: Updating the self-service portal: helm upgrade redhat-rhaap-portal with the same values file (or Developer > Helm > Upgrade in the console), or pass clusterRouterBase, imageRegistry, pluginMode and ociPluginImage with --set flags for OCI or tarball delivery.
questions: How do I upgrade the self-service portal Helm release?
Can I install the self-service portal with --set instead of a values file?
